# dsh-supervisor
DSH Host + Client plugin for per-session supervision, role-aware Supervisors, durable responsibility
assignments, context-health warnings and recoverable Handoff workflows.
## Platform repositories

This repository maintains the DSH plugin, `dsh-supervisor@0.2.4`.
The Codex edition is developed and

packaged independently in
`Harzva/codex-supervisor`,
with the plugin identifier `harzva-supervisor`

. The two editions have
separate build, installation and marketplace submission flows.

## Supervisor configuration
The plugin accepts an optional legacy-compatible `mentors` array. Existing `faculties` configuration
s are automatically projected into role-aware Supervisors, so older profiles continue to work.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Supported roles are `architecture`, `research`, `execution`, `verification`, and `handoff`.
## Matrix API
- `GET /dsh-supervisor/states?ids=...` — bounded compact states including mentor, assignment, health

and Handoff summary.
- `GET /dsh-supervisor/mentors` — public mentor roster without model routes.
-

`POST /dsh-supervisor/assignment` — set one primary mentor and at most two collaborators.
- `POST /
dsh-supervisor/state` — update supervision mode/strategy and a per-session, per-Supervisor model ove

rride through `patch.supervisorModel: { supervisorId, route }`.
- `GET|POST /dsh-supervisor/handoff`
— inspect or advance a Handoff transaction.
The Handoff route uses an idempotent transaction with a preallocated target session id. It supports
model-generated drafts, validated safe fallback summaries when a provider is unavailable, cold-sessi
on prompting through the official connection API, workspace/Preset inheritance, and bidirectional so
urce/target navigation in the matrix drawer.
All APIs are local-profile JSON routes. They do not expose live Cordis objects or raw session logs.
## State and recovery
Assignments, per-Supervisor model overrides, successful compaction counts, Handoff records and bound
ed audit metadata are stored atomically under the active DSH home. Removing the plugin row disables
the feature without deleting sessions. Source sessions are never automatically deleted or archived.

itory-only `evidence/p0/` bundle. A clean clone does not require the

or pack, and P0 verification never overwrites
